title: ReleaseAuthorization (external-effect release gate)
$comment: Structural residue of the effect.* rules (P0-5). The immutable, integrity-protected artifact that is the sole capability for an irreversible external effect (effect.authorization.artifact). It commits to the exact quarantine bytes, the exact evidence view, and the exact policy snapshot — everything a bare verdict lacks — and it is the versioned wire artifact the release worker consumes (effect.authorization.wire-artifact): no evaluator-internal state crosses the boundary. The field set here is the normative commit list; removing a member is a breaking change to the authorization contract. Canonicalized with jcs-rfc8785 (P0-4); counts and positions are decimal strings. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

issuer.$comment: The authorization issuer synthesizes the decision from the per-scope vector for the exact EvidenceViewID (audit.release.synthesis).

spineVariantIds.$comment: The exact proof-variant spine, origin → head, the evidence was evaluated over (effect.gate.full-spine); the last member is the head variant.

sourceVariantIds.$comment: Exact variants of profile-required consumed sources (commitment.source-root.canonicalizer-binding); empty when the profile requires none.

evidenceViewId.$comment: evidence.manifest.identity: the exact view the terminal verdict is bound to.

items.$comment: Members of the scope-catalog.json scopeName enum; the pattern is structural, the enum is the semantic bound (claims.catalog.enumerated).

policyProfileId.$comment: The archetype this authorization was derived under (claims.profile.external-effect).

inputSnapshotDigests.$comment: Lifecycle / registry / trust-profile snapshots the evaluation read; a mismatch at dispatch time forces re-evaluation (effect.release.freshness).

verdictArtifactDigest.$comment: Digest of the underlying committed evidence vector artifact (claims.vector.durable-commit).

decision.$comment: A deny is a DecisionRecord / effect-status outcome, never a ReleaseAuthorization.

validUntil.$comment: Hard bound: past this instant the authorization cannot dispatch (effect.release.freshness).
